functions.//: The deployed bundle is the compiled lib/, so the sources above are excluded. CI builds separately, but this keeps a local `firebase deploy` from shipping stale output.

rewrites.//: Must precede the catch-all: rewrites are evaluated in order and the first match wins, so a `**` rule above this one would answer every API call with the app shell. pinTag keeps the function version and the static release rolling back together.
Client-side routing: /today and friends are not files. The service worker's navigateFallback only helps once it is installed, so the first visit to a deep link needs this.

headers.//: Default to revalidating. Headers match the *request* path, not the rewritten file, so a rule for /index.html never fires for / or /today — those have to be covered by this.
Overrides the rule above: filenames are content-hashed, so these can never go stale. Later entries win.
no-store rather than no-cache: an access token must not be written to disk at all, which is a stronger claim than revalidating before reuse.
